name: anomaly_kpi
$comment: AnomalyGen-aligned anomaly tagging bank for the anomaly_visual_qa stage of the Visual Attribute Search pipeline. Encodes the 21 anomaly categories of the 22-category KPI ontology ('normal' is the 22nd category, implied when every question is answered No) as independent Yes/No BCQs, reproducing AnomalyGen's multi-label 'include every category that genuinely happens' semantics. The canonical ontology (ids, groups, descriptions, and label normalization) lives in code at core.utils.anomaly_ontology in this repository (migrated verbatim from the legacy script/utils/anomaly_ontology.py); keep this bank's ids in sync with it. Each question id is 'anom_<category_id>' so a clip's predicted category set is exactly the ids answered Yes. Run via visual_qa --generation-mode window-direct-vlm --input-source original --single-window, outputs redirected to the visual_qa_anomaly/ sidecar so they do not clobber the per-track person_attribute_visual_qa/ sidecar. aggregation 'any' leans toward recall and is a no-op under --single-window.

questions.question: Does this clip show a traffic accident, vehicle crash, collision, rollover, or the immediate aftermath of a crash?
Does this clip show unsafe or illegal traffic behavior, such as wrong-way driving, illegal lane changing, red-light running, illegal parking or blocking, or illegal pedestrian crossing?
Does this clip show obstacles, debris, stopped objects, animals, or other visible blockage obstructing traffic or creating a road hazard?
Does this clip show an animal attacking, chasing, hurting, or threatening people, entering an unsafe public area, or obstructing traffic or pathways?
Does this clip show a robbery, mugging, or forceful theft from a person?
Does this clip show a person stealing, shoplifting, or taking property unlawfully?
Does this clip show a mutual physical fight between two or more people who are actively engaged?
Does this clip show a one-sided physical assault, beating, kicking, pushing, dragging, restraint, or abuse of another person?
Does this clip show shooting, gunfire, a visible gun attack, or the immediate aftermath of gunfire?
Does this clip show a riot, crowd violence, or a large-scale violent disturbance?
Does this clip show vandalism, property destruction, or deliberate damage to public or private property?
Does this clip show visible fire, smoke, a blast, an explosion, or the immediate aftermath of an explosion or fire?
Does this clip show flooding, a tsunami, or dangerous water inundation?
Does this clip show a tornado, severe windstorm, or wind-driven hazardous event?
Does this clip show an avalanche, landslide, mudslide, or earth or snow collapse?
Does this clip show objects falling from height, falling from shelves or racks, or creating danger after falling?
Does this clip show a suspicious, dangerous, thrown, abandoned, or hazardous object?
Does this clip show a person falling, slipping, tripping, collapsing, or lying down after a fall?
Does this clip show a person running in a suspicious, fleeing, panic, chase, or hazardous context?

Does this clip show unsafe behavior in a warehouse, warehouse aisle, loading or storage area, industrial stockroom, or similar workplace, including a PPE violation, unsafe climbing, unsafe forklift interaction, smoking or vaping violation, or industrial near miss?
Does this clip show an industrial liquid spill, leak, overflow, or spillover involving containers, barrels, boxes, forklifts, or warehouse materials?
